#: This gets merged into every version as #/local.

ScanScheme.title: Scan Scheme
ScanScheme.description: Order in which to scan the network.
ScanScheme.x-description-append: Valid values are 'up' to scan from the first address, 'down' to scan from the last, 'edges' to scan in from both ends and 'random' to scan randomly.

#: The zeroth element of this is always null since there is no version 0.

host-node.title: Host Node
host-node.description: pScheduler to contact about running the test.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum addresses to scan.  Default is to scan the entire network.

parallel.title: Parallel
parallel.description: Number of addresses to scan in parallel.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a response.
